headline: SPR Auto Technologies Limited completes Qualified Institutional Placement
sum: SPR Auto Technologies' Finance and Investment Committee has approved allotment of equity shares under a QIP. The NSE disclosure confirms completion of the institutional capital raise, though the exact quantum and price remain unreported in the primary NSE filing.
implication: QIP completion without public valuation disclosure is common in tier-2 auto-ancillary capital raises; partners should monitor for follow-up NSE/BSE disclosures of consideration, investor register, and lock-in covenants under the Listing Regulations.
detail: SPR Auto Technologies Limited, an automotive components and technologies manufacturer, has concluded its QIP by securing Finance and Investment Committee approval for the allotment of equity shares to qualified institutional buyers. The transaction was disclosed to NSE on 20 August 2026. The specific investment size, price per share, and number of shares allotted have not been disclosed in the NSE archival document itself; these details typically appear in separate BSE/NSE announcements or the company's investor-relations disclosures under the ICDR Regulations.

triggers.note: QIP can only be issued by listed companies; pricing is typically based on a 30-day volume-weighted average price (VWAP) or a discount thereto; institutional buyer eligibility is mandated.
Post-allotment, a one-year lock-in applies to QIP shares for promoters and 40% of QIP shares for other institutional buyers (subject to SEBI exemptions).
QIP issuance authority flows from board resolution delegating power to Finance/Investment Committee; no shareholder approval typically required for QIP under this route.
